recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if OO or Imaging Integration later changes the allowed Observation.derivedFrom target set; no FHIR core source correction is needed for FHIR-14034 now.
issue_request: FHIR-14034 was a Published OO change request raised for STU3 asking that derived or inferred Observations be able to reference imaging, specifically by adding Reference(ImagingStudy) to the old Observation.related.target model. Its final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution adopted a broader replacement of Observation.related with explicit relationship elements and included ImagingStudy among Observation.derivedFrom targets.
initial_application: No repository commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-14034 was found. The same voted relationship-resolution text appears on FHIR-10118, and git commit 5bdc6559670c09dbdcbfcdf5f716f84455c6e600 implemented that relationship refactor by disabling Observation.related/related.target and adding Observation.derivedFrom with Reference(DocumentReference|ImagingStudy|Media|QuestionnaireResponse|Observation|Sequence).
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml target list for Observation.derivedFrom includes ImagingStudy, ImagingSelection, DocumentReference, QuestionnaireResponse, Observation, and MolecularSequence. Later source evolution accounts for differences from the STU3 text, such as Sequence becoming MolecularSequence and ImagingSelection being added.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current authoritative source already satisfies the seed issue, and adding redundant prose or reintroducing the retired related.target framing would risk drift.
